mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM inquiry_invite inv JOIN inquiry i ON i.id = inv.inquiry_id AND i.is_deleted = 0 WHERE inv.supplier_tenant_id = #{supplierTenantId} AND inv.invite_status = 'accepted' AND inv.is_deleted = 0 AND i.status IN ('open', 'quoting') AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM quote q WHERE q.inquiry_id = inv.inquiry_id AND q.supplier_tenant_id = #{supplierTenantId} AND q.status != 'withdrawn' AND q.is_deleted = 0 )
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT inquiry_id) FROM inquiry_award WHERE supplier_tenant_id = #{supplierTenantId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM contract WHERE is_deleted = 0
